_meta.description: Merge Combinator momentum ledger — dated public record of ecosystem milestones, field operations, program launches, announcements, published analysis, and network activity worth pointing at. Rendered at https://mergecombinator.com/momentum.
_meta.note: Entries below are drawn from public content. Keep product backlog, site launches, directory refreshes, and usability work out of this stream; those belong in changelogs or the product itself. Add new entries at the top; the page sorts by date descending regardless. Set featured to false for small milestones that belong in the record but should not enter the Latest evidence rail.

origin.own: Written by Merge Combinator — signals, milestones, program/field updates. Rendered as a featured card.
origin.reshare: Someone else's story we're pointing at — a builder's own announcement, press coverage, or a partner's update. Rendered compact and muted, always attributed and linked to the original. See scripts/momentum-curate.mjs.

types.milestone: Company and ecosystem milestones — raises, contracts, awards (own)
types.field: Field operations — exercises, deployments, operator integration (own)
types.announcement: Public product, field, or company announcements (own)
types.builder: A builder company's own news — their announcement, reshared (reshare)
types.press: Industry/press coverage mentioning MC, the Combine, or its builders (reshare)
types.partner: An institutional partner's announcement — primes, program offices, cohort partners. Requires a `why` field explaining why it's on this ledger (reshare)
